content.text:
I couldn't create the file. A project hook from the team-workflow plugin blocks writes to `migrations/` because changes there need a human to review them. I didn't try to get around it.

Please create `migrations/0001_add_last_login.sql` with this content:

```sql
-- 0001_add_last_login
-- Records when each user last logged in. Nullable: existing users and
-- users who have never logged in have no value.

ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN last_login_at TIMESTAMP NULL;
```

- **Nullable, no default:** users who already exist, and anyone who has never logged in, get `NULL` instead of a made-up timestamp.
- **Plain SQL type:** nothing in the repo says which database you use (`src/db.js` is an in-memory store), so I used standard `TIMESTAMP`. On Postgres you may want `TIMESTAMPTZ` instead.
- **Not wired into the app yet:** the in-memory seed data in `src/db.js` and `UserRepository` don't know about `last_login_at`. If you want them to, I can add the field to the seed rows and a `recordLogin(id, when)` method to `UserRepository`. Those files aren't blocked by the hook.
